Base directory for this skill: /tmp/skilltest-olaa_stk/.claude/skills/acme-release-notes

# Acme release notes

Release notes live in `RELEASE_NOTES.md`, newest release first. From v2.4 on we
use the format below (older entries use a plain legacy format: leave them exactly
as they are). Add the new release directly under the file's title.

## Format

```
## v<VERSION> (<YYYY-MM-DD>)

### Breaking changes
- <what changed and what users must do> [ACME-<id>] (thanks @<author>)

### Features
- <user-facing description> [ACME-<id>] (thanks @<author>)

### Fixes
- <user-facing description> [ACME-<id>] (thanks @<author>)
```

Rules:

1. Take the version from the `VERSION` file and the date from `RELEASE_DATE`.
2. Sections always appear in this order. Write `- None.` under an empty section;
   never drop a section.
3. A PR title starting with `ACME-<id>!:` (note the `!`) is a breaking change.
   Titles with `fix`, `crash` or `bug` go under Fixes; everything else is a Feature.
4. Every bullet ends with the ticket in square brackets, then the author:
   `[ACME-412] (thanks @mira)`.
5. Rewrite PR titles for users: say what they can now do, not what the code does.

cd /tmp/skilltest-olaa_stk; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='RELEASE_NOTES.md'
s=open(p).read()
head='Release notes\n=============\n'
new='''
## v2.4.0 (2026-10-20)

### Breaking changes
- The deprecated `--legacy` flag has been removed from `sync`; remove it from any scripts or scheduled jobs that still pass it. [ACME-421] (thanks @mira)

### Features
- You can now export reports to CSV from the `report` command. [ACME-412] (thanks @mira)
- Uploads now automatically retry with backoff when the server is temporarily unavailable (HTTP 503), so transient outages no longer fail your upload. [ACME-415] (thanks @jonas)

### Fixes
- Acme no longer crashes when the config file is empty. [ACME-419] (thanks @tom)
- Monthly summaries now show correct totals in leap years. [ACME-423] (thanks @priya)
'''
assert s.startswith(head)
open(p,'w').write(head+new+s[len(head):])
EOF
cat RELEASE_NOTES.md
